title: feat(scenarios): the external driver contract carries the reported cost and tokens, and the scorecard states a channel's authoring cost
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBM2HsDA1RWAf8uRHt8uPH97)_

Fixes #31170

Clause-②: no — `@objectstack/scenarios` has never been published (`npm view @objectstack/scenarios` answers E404 on 2026-11-10; control: `npm view @objectstack/cli version` answers 18.3.0), so no released accept-set or public surface widens
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:外部驱动契约 `objectstack-scenario-driver/1` 的回答新增三个可选字段:本次调用的花费(美元)、输入 token、输出 token。每一轮的记录照实带上;评分卡和画廊页给出"建应用花了多少",只有每个建应用回合都报了花费才给出总数,否则写 `not reported`。
- **为什么改**:要在同一批场景卡上比较本地通道与云端通道(cloud#4220)的准确率、耗时和花费;此前外部命令一报花费就被判为无效输出,任何外部通道都无法按花费比较。
- **风险与回滚**:只加可选字段,不报用量的命令照旧有效;该包从未发布,不影响任何已发布面;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/scorecard.ts` 的 `authorCost`(全部回合都报了才给数);`src/runner/drivers/external.ts` 的新字段与"未报不记零";`src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 的 `summarize`(记录逐轮携带)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/external-driver.test.ts test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件、55 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The contract** (`ExternalTurnSchema`, `runner/drivers/external.ts`): the `author` / `ask` answer gains three optional keys, `reportedCostUsd` (a number, zero or more), `inputTokens` and `outputTokens` (whole numbers, zero or more). The schema stays strict: a figure of another shape (a string, `null`, a negative cost, a fractional count) is `invalid-output(…)`, never a guessed figure. An answer with none of them is valid exactly as before.
- **The turn meta**: the external driver carries each figure into `ParsedTurn.meta` only when the command reported it. `meta.reportedCostUsd` is the field the `claude` CLI's `total_cost_usd` already lands in (`runner/transcript.ts`); `meta.inputTokens` / `meta.outputTokens` are new.
- **The run record** (`TurnSummary`, `runner/orchestrate.ts`): every turn now carries `reportedCostUsd`, `inputTokens` and `outputTokens` when its driver reported them, the `claude` CLI's cost included. A turn that reported none records none: the keys are absent, never `0`.
- **The scorecard** (`runner/scorecard.ts`): `AuthorCost` (`turns`, `reported`, `usd?`) on the card (`CardScorecard.authorCost`) and on each mode (`ModeScorecard.authorCost`), computed by `authorCost()` over the authoring turns that ran (build and iterate). `usd` is set only when every one of them reported a cost; otherwise there is no `usd` and the rendered text is `not reported` (`not reported (2 of 3 author turns reported a cost)` when some did). The markdown gains an `author cost:` line under the packages line and an `Author cost` row. A reported zero is a reading and sums as zero.
- **The gallery page** (`export/exporter.ts`): each app's `README.md` gains `- Author cost (as the driver reported it): …` on the same rule, read from the record's scorecard; a record written before this change has no `authorCost` and reads `not reported`.
- **README**: the contract section states the usage keys, the no-usage rule and why the contract name stays; the runner section gains a **Cost** bullet; the old contract bullet **Cost** (about the login and the billing variables) is renamed **Login**, so the page has one "cost" meaning.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/31170-scenarios-external-driver-usage.md`, `@objectstack/scenarios` patch, both declaration lines.

## Why

The scorecard has to compare the local and cloud channels on accuracy, time and cost. The built-in driver recorded the cost the CLI reports, but the external contract refused a cost key as invalid output, so no external command (cloud#4220's cloud agent, a Codex wrapper) could be compared on cost.

The contract name stays `objectstack-scenario-driver/1`: the change only adds optional answer keys, and the inputs a command reads are unchanged. A runner built from a checkout before this change refuses an answer that carries one of the new keys (the schema is strict), but no such runner was ever released (the package is unpublished), so no shipped runner breaks. The README tells a command that must also serve such a runner to leave the keys out.

## Tests

- `test/runner/external-driver.test.ts`, contract cases: an answer that reports no usage stays valid and records no cost and no tokens (the card's "a command reporting no usage stays valid" test); an answer that reports usage carries each figure into the turn, and a reported zero is kept; five malformed figures are each `invalid-output` naming the key.
- `test/runner/external-driver.test.ts`, end to end over the stub command on the real crm card: the existing key case now also asserts the no-usage run's gallery page reads `not reported`; a new case has every authoring turn report a cost and tokens (persona turns tokens only) and asserts the record's turns, the scorecard (`{ turns: 3, reported: 3, usd: 0.75 }`, `$0.50` / `$0.25` per mode), the gallery page and its `scorecard.md`.
- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, a new top-level describe over `runCard`: all authoring turns reported; one reported none (the card and that mode `not reported`, never a partial sum); reported zeros; no turn reported (no turn in the record carries the key); a skipped mode, and a scorecard written before the field existed.

<details><summary>Red → green, ablations</summary>

- **Red leg** (new tests against main's `src`, tree-only restore of `packages/qa/scenarios/src` to `60f8149e`, restored from HEAD and proven by an empty `git diff HEAD`): 9 failed / 46 passed (55). The no-usage contract case passes on both sides, as a compatibility pin should.
- **Green**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` exit 0; the package's vitest run 30 files passed, 651 tests passed, 14 skipped; the two `test/build/**` files red only for a missing `dist`, then 2 files / 14 tests passed after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor x1 → x0 with the blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`; the tests import `src` directly, so no `dist` leg applies):
  - "never a zero", driver side: `external.ts` writes `reportedCostUsd: out.reportedCostUsd ?? 0` → 3 failed (the no-usage contract case and both end-to-end cases).
  - "never a zero", record side: `orchestrate.ts` `summarize` writes `?? 0` → 5 failed.
  - "every author turn reported it": `scorecard.ts` states the sum when any one turn reported a cost (the anchor `turns.length` … `=== turns.length` replaced by a test of `costs.length` alone) → 1 failed (the one-turn-reported-none case).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Ask 2's "exactly as the built-in drivers' reported cost is carried", measured at `60f8149e`:** the built-in cost reached the turn meta (and so the recording) and stopped there: `summarize` never copied it, so no run record held any cost. Ask 3 needs it in the record, so this PR carries every driver's reported cost into `TurnSummary`; the `claude` CLI's figure now reaches the record and the scorecard too. That adds `runner/orchestrate.ts` to the claim's file surface (`TurnSummary` and `summarize`, 12 lines); it is none of #31999's files.
- **Field names:** the record had no token field, so the names are `inputTokens` and `outputTokens`; the cost key reuses `reportedCostUsd` from the contract through the meta to the record.
- **Scope of the stated cost:** the authoring turns (build and iterate), per mode and per card, as the card asks. Persona turns carry their own figures per turn in the record and are not summed.
- **Noted, not filed:** the built-in drivers read no tokens: the `claude` result line and Codex's `turn.completed` both carry a `usage` object, and the Codex driver reads no cost either, so a Codex run's author cost reads `not reported`. The gallery `index.json` is unchanged: the cost is on each app's page and scorecard, and the index schema is strict and versioned. `carrier: none`.
- **Main:** `origin/main` (`eb66b74f`, 3 commits past the base, none in `packages/qa/scenarios` or its dependency closure) is merged at `bda4f788`. The branch's delta against `main` is still these 10 files (+330 / -13). `packages/spec` moved on main's side (`liveness/action.json`), so spec was rebuilt and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reads all 14 artifacts up to date. `packages/qa/scenarios/src` and `test` are byte-identical between the tested commit `65db6d1b` and `bda4f788`, so the package's tests were not re-run.

## Verification

All readings are on this container (a shared box); every heavy command ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0 (at `65db6d1b`; `src` and `test` unchanged since).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 30 files passed, 651 tests passed, 14 skipped; `test/build/built-consumer.test.ts` and `test/build/packed-tarball.test.ts` red only for a missing `dist`, then 2 files / 14 tests passed after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the 8 touched source and test files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `bda4f788`: 62 derived commands, each run serially, each `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciles "62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". (At `0bff3e16`, before the merge: 61 exit 0, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 for want of built output, measured green on the rerun; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone, then 48 cases passed.)
- Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
- Every other family is CI's: the PR's check-runs are the reading.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes on the touched files.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer summary is in Chinese by the repository's rule).
